text.card: A red giant 5,145 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.05 solar masses and 20.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,982 K at its surface.
